name: pressprotocol-extension
description: Browser extension for censorship-resistant content access and sovereign web clipping

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/background.ts src/popup.ts src/clipper.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --target=chrome100 --format=esm && esbuild src/content.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --target=chrome100 --format=iife && pnpm run copy
scripts.copy: cp manifest.json dist/ && cp popup.html dist/ && cp popup.css dist/ && cp -r icons dist/
